_comment: Static fallback for the freshness strip. This file documents the shape of
the status.json a project's CI would publish, and holds the last values
that were verified by hand. The strip's inline HTML is generated from
these values, so a visitor with no JS, a failed fetch or a 404 still sees
real numbers instead of a spinner.
No project publishes the feed today, and job-market-intelligence has
decided against the committed-file version of it: writing status.json to
main produced two bot commits a day, 58 in the first month, burying the
human history. A gh-pages publish alongside its dbt docs would give the
strip live values without touching main. Until then this snapshot is the
Only figures that can be verified from a project's own artefacts appear
here. rows_in_warehouse and last_ingest_at are null on purpose: they are
runtime facts that only the live feed can supply, and inventing them would
defeat the point of the strip. They render as an em dash.
